reasons: AC1-AC4 all bind to ac<N>-* nodes; trace.json shows 25/25 entries ok=true.
AC1 and AC2 are visual claims and carry capture-helper screenshots that show the rail on the Perps tab and the destination list already narrowed to Crypto.
AC2 asserts the destination's own filter-select-button reads Crypto, so navigation alone cannot pass the recipe.
AC3 and AC4 are non-visual claims proved by named jest assertions guarded with assert_output "1 passed" plus assert_exit_code 0, not by screenshots.
Reverting the PR fails the recipe: ac1-wait-category-rail timed out on the pre-move run, which is the empirical revert check.

graph_integrity.reason: Single reachable chain from gate-cdp-reachable to done; no switch/default routing around an assertion, no manual action, no wait > 500ms standing in for wait_for.

action_contract.reason: Every node uses a manifest-declared action and only manifest-declared fields; validated with mm-harness run --plan (status pass, zero findings) before the live run.

ac_coverage.reason: Four ACs, four ac<N>-* node groups, no AC left to a generic setup node and none marked UNTESTABLE.

evidence_contract_basics.reason: Both screenshots are preceded by a ui.wait_for on the claimed target and a ui.scroll into view; artifact-manifest.json records provider capture-helper for both, not extension-dom-raster or Page.captureScreenshot. Hidden claims (skeleton gating, keyboard activation) carry test evidence rather than padded screenshots.

perps_state_setup.reason: The rail is derived from the live market-list stream, so the only state needed is a loaded Perps tab; no position, order or balance state is required and none was faked. ui.navigate page=perps is the high-level action for this surface, so no raw setup steps were written.

good_patterns: assert_output "1 passed" paired with assert_exit_code 0, because jest -t exits 0 when a title filter matches nothing
CSS-selector wait_for on button[...]:not([disabled]):not([tabindex="-1"]) to prove focusability, which a screenshot cannot show
explicit ui.scroll into view before a visual assertion on a section below the fold
